g.text: Residue of the catalytic domain, numbered as in the structure file
An interface has no centre. The residues of the catalytic domain that touch the N-terminal domain
stand in a column, as boxes, ordered along the interface and not by their sequence: neighbours
in the column are neighbours in space; those of the N-terminal domain around it. A line is a pair
of residues, at the shortest of its contacts of one kind.
All 6 residues of the catalytic domain at the interface are shown, with 13 contacts.
PAE (predicted aligned error) is the model's expected error, in ångström, in placing one residue
of a contact relative to the other: low is confident, about 32 means no idea. It is not pLDDT, which
No contact here reaches 5 Å, so none carries a PAE on its line.
